hooks.name: Enforce AI review protocol before completing a feature
hooks.description: On a code-modifying tool use, remind the agent to follow the AI review protocol loop and pre-completion gates before declaring work done.

action.prompt: Before finishing: follow .kiro/steering/08-ai-review-protocol.md — READ → PLAN → IMPLEMENT → TEST → REVIEW → DOCS, and pass all pre-completion gates (architecture, dependency, side-effect, performance, regression, test, documentation). "Build passes" is not "done". For Godot changes, the authoritative test is: godot --headless --path . -s res://tests/run_tests.gd. Keep changes data-driven and respect the layer boundaries and the persistent/runtime/presentation partition for core systems.
